title: Liquidity and Float
description: The stocks with high liquidity (average daily value traded over the last three months) and the low-float ones (free float from the latest shareholding pattern). Linked from Market Watch.

list.name: min_value_cr
list.label: High liquidity over, ₹ crore a day
list.description: The average daily value traded over the last three months a stock must exceed.

list.name: max_float_pct
list.label: Low float at most, %
list.description: The largest free float, as a share of all the company's shares, counted as low. 25% is the least a listed company must have in public hands.

panels.description: What the two lists hold. Pick the amount and the share at the top of the page.

options.content: High liquidity: average daily value traded over the last 3 months (average volume × average close) above the amount picked. Low float: free float (the shares neither the promoters nor the government hold) at or below the share picked, from the latest quarter's shareholding pattern.

panels.description: The newest of the last CAN SLIM scan, which reads every stock's daily bars each market evening, and the last company page read from screener.in, where the shareholding comes from.

panels.title: High liquidity: over ₹$min_value_cr crore a day
panels.description: Stocks trading on the latest session whose average daily value over the last three months is above the amount picked.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(session_date) AS day FROM daily_bar),
recent AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, AVG(b.volume) AS avg_volume, AVG(b.close) AS avg_close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date > date(latest.day, '-3 months')
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
last_bar AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, b.close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date = latest.day
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Stocks"
FROM recent r
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = r.instrument_id AND i.segment = 'CASH'
JOIN last_bar l ON l.instrument_id = r.instrument_id
WHERE r.avg_volume * r.avg_close > $min_value_cr * 1e7

panels.title: Low float: $max_float_pct% or less
panels.description: Companies whose free float, in their latest quarter's shareholding pattern, is at or below the share picked. Only companies with that pattern held are counted: see the next tile.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(session_date) AS day FROM daily_bar),
recent AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, AVG(b.volume) AS avg_volume, AVG(b.close) AS avg_close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date > date(latest.day, '-3 months')
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
last_bar AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, b.close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date = latest.day
),
holding AS (
  SELECT h.instrument_id, h.period, h.promoters, h.government, h.fiis, h.diis, h.public,
         100 - COALESCE(h.promoters, 0) - COALESCE(h.government, 0) AS free_float
  FROM company_holding h
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE h.period = (SELECT MAX(x.period) FROM company_holding x WHERE x.instrument_id = h.instrument_id)
    AND h.period >= strftime('%Y-%m', latest.day, '-4 months')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Stocks"
FROM holding h
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = h.instrument_id AND i.segment = 'CASH'
WHERE h.free_float <= $max_float_pct

panels.title: Shareholding held for
panels.description: How many companies have their latest quarter's shareholding pattern here, of the stocks trading. The patterns come from screener.in's company pages: every tracked company each evening, and up to company.profile.untracked.max.pages.per.run others a night, each again after 90 days, so the low-float list fills over the weeks. `CanSlimMain profiles --max-other-pages N` reads more in one go, 12 seconds a page.

panels.title: High liquidity and low float: over ₹$min_value_cr crore a day, free float of $max_float_pct% or less
panels.description: The stocks on both lists below: trading on the latest session, with an average daily value over the last three months (average volume × average close) above the amount picked, and a free float (the shares neither the promoters nor the government hold, in the latest quarter's shareholding pattern) at or below the share picked. Few shares free to trade, yet enough traded to get in and out. Fewest free shares first, then the most traded. Only companies whose screener.in page has been read can be here: see the tile above. Click a symbol for it on Stock Trend.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(session_date) AS day FROM daily_bar),
recent AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, AVG(b.volume) AS avg_volume, AVG(b.close) AS avg_close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date > date(latest.day, '-3 months')
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
last_bar AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, b.close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date = latest.day
),
holding AS (
  SELECT h.instrument_id, h.period, h.promoters, h.government, h.fiis, h.diis, h.public,
         100 - COALESCE(h.promoters, 0) - COALESCE(h.government, 0) AS free_float
  FROM company_holding h
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE h.period = (SELECT MAX(x.period) FROM company_holding x WHERE x.instrument_id = h.instrument_id)
    AND h.period >= strftime('%Y-%m', latest.day, '-4 months')
)
SELECT i.symbol AS "Symbol",
       ROUND(h.free_float, 1) AS "Free float %",
       ROUND(r.avg_volume * r.avg_close / 1e7, 2) AS "Avg daily value, ₹ crore",
       ROUND(p.market_cap_cr * h.free_float / 100) AS "Free-float market cap, ₹ crore",
       p.market_cap_cr AS "Market cap, ₹ crore",
       h.promoters AS "Promoters %",
       h.government AS "Government %",
       substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(h.period, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3)
         || ' ' || substr(h.period, 1, 4) AS "Quarter",
       l.close AS "Latest close, ₹",
       r.sessions AS "Sessions"
FROM holding h
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = h.instrument_id AND i.segment = 'CASH'
JOIN recent r ON r.instrument_id = h.instrument_id
JOIN last_bar l ON l.instrument_id = h.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN company_profile p ON p.instrument_id = h.instrument_id
WHERE h.free_float <= $max_float_pct
  AND r.avg_volume * r.avg_close > $min_value_cr * 1e7
ORDER BY h.free_float, r.avg_volume * r.avg_close DESC, i.symbol

panels.title: High liquidity: over ₹$min_value_cr crore traded a day, over the last 3 months
panels.description: Every listed NSE and BSE equity the nightly scan prices, trading on the latest session, whose average daily volume times its average close over the last three months (to the latest session) is above the amount picked, most traded first. Volume is the stock's own exchange's: NSE's for a stock listed there, BSE's for one only on BSE. Market cap and free float are shown where the company's screener.in page has been read. Click a symbol for it on Stock Trend.

panels.title: Low float: free float of $max_float_pct% or less
panels.description: Companies whose shares held by neither the promoters nor the government come to the share picked or less, in their latest quarter's shareholding pattern (a pattern is filed up to three weeks after its quarter ends, so one up to about four months old counts; an older one is left out). Fewest shares free first, with who holds the rest, the market cap and the part of it that is free float, and the average daily value traded over the last three months. A low float moves more on less buying and selling. Click a symbol for it on Stock Trend.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(session_date) AS day FROM daily_bar),
recent AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, AVG(b.volume) AS avg_volume, AVG(b.close) AS avg_close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date > date(latest.day, '-3 months')
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
last_bar AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, b.close
  FROM daily_bar b
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date = latest.day
),
holding AS (
  SELECT h.instrument_id, h.period, h.promoters, h.government, h.fiis, h.diis, h.public,
         100 - COALESCE(h.promoters, 0) - COALESCE(h.government, 0) AS free_float
  FROM company_holding h
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE h.period = (SELECT MAX(x.period) FROM company_holding x WHERE x.instrument_id = h.instrument_id)
    AND h.period >= strftime('%Y-%m', latest.day, '-4 months')
)
SELECT i.symbol AS "Symbol",
       ROUND(h.free_float, 1) AS "Free float %",
       h.promoters AS "Promoters %",
       h.government AS "Government %",
       h.fiis AS "FIIs %",
       h.diis AS "DIIs %",
       h.public AS "Public %",
       substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(h.period, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3)
         || ' ' || substr(h.period, 1, 4) AS "Quarter",
       p.market_cap_cr AS "Market cap, ₹ crore",
       ROUND(p.market_cap_cr * h.free_float / 100) AS "Free-float market cap, ₹ crore",
       ROUND(r.avg_volume * r.avg_close / 1e7, 2) AS "Avg daily value, ₹ crore"
FROM holding h
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = h.instrument_id AND i.segment = 'CASH'
LEFT JOIN company_profile p ON p.instrument_id = h.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN recent r ON r.instrument_id = h.instrument_id
WHERE h.free_float <= $max_float_pct
ORDER BY h.free_float, i.symbol
